tasks.title: RPC / event: bash
acceptance: Implement bash using shared canonical runtime with correlated responses/event ordering
Test protocol through RPC process, including failures and cancellation
implementation: RpcMode accepts bash requests, validates command input, runs them asynchronously through ConversationRun and the shared CodingTools instance, emits request-correlated bash_execution_update events, and returns output, exitCode, cancelled, truncated and optional fullOutputPath fields.

ConversationRun persists each direct shell result as a bash_execution entry, projects default results into context, omits excludeFromContext=true results from provider messages, and flushes deferred entries into history after the active turn settles.

ExtensionRegistration user_bash handlers from admitted extension catalogs can claim direct RPC requests by returning BashExecutionResult, publish correlated update events, or return null to defer; failures emit extension_error and continue through the handler list before shell fallback, and abort_bash cancellation reaches the handler token.
evidence: RpcModeTests.BashCommandStreamsCorrelatedOutputAndReturnsStructuredExitResult verifies combined stdout/stderr, exitCode 7, correlated updates before response, default context projection and follow-up history consistency.

RpcModeTests.BashCommandCanPersistResultWithoutAddingItToModelContext verifies exclusion across JSON restore and a restored follow-up prompt; RpcBashProcessTests verifies get_entries retains the entry while get_messages omits it.

ConversationSessionTests, CompactionTests and SessionExportTests verify malformed inactive execution rejection, recent context retention across compaction, and escaped HTML export of execution details.
RpcModeTests.BashCommandReturnsTailAndPrivateFullOutputMetadataWhenTruncated verifies the last 2000 lines, truncated flag and private complete log path.

RpcModeTests.UserBashHandlerCanStreamAndReplaceDirectBash checks the result and event path for a replacing handler; RpcModeTests.FailedAndDeclinedUserBashHandlersFallThroughToTheShell checks failure reporting and fallback; RpcModeTests.AbortBashCancelsAnActiveUserBashHandler checks cancellation; ExtensionCatalogTests checks project handler trust gating.

RpcBashProcessTests.RpcProcessReturnsBashResultsAndHandlesAbortBash checks the actual CLI structured result and cancellation; RpcBashProcessTests.RpcProcessRoutesBashThroughAnExplicitlyLoadedExtension verifies Program.cs wires an extension handler into RPC, including its correlated update.
